posts.overlay_text: POV: you reread your journal from 6 months ago and barely recognize yourself
posts.ig_caption:
She's different now. 🌙

posts.fb_caption:
Sometimes the most radical thing you can do is slow down and listen to yourself — really listen. ✨

Tonight's prompt: what is your heart telling you right now that your mind keeps talking over? Write without editing.
posts.hypothesis: Using the Plath aphorism_plate because literary quotes in the 12–16 word range earn strong saves in the cohort (per @thegoodquote and @yung_pueblo patterns), and the October reflective season amplifies introspective content; testing whether a recognized literary voice outperforms 'Unknown' attribution we've leaned on lately.

posts.label: Quote 2
posts.quote: To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.
posts.fb_caption:
When did you last just… sit with yourself, without an agenda? No scroll, no task list, just you and your thoughts. 🍂

This week's prompt: describe the last time you felt truly still inside — what were you doing, and what did that stillness tell you? Save this one to come back to.
posts.hypothesis: Running a prompt_card with a Lao Tzu stillness quote in October because autumn content historically outperforms summer in the journaling niche; testing whether a prompt framed around stillness (rather than growth/action) earns more saves than recent action-oriented quotes.
